description: Defines an ApiClient class facilitating communication with a backend API, including authentication, request handling, token refresh, and various CRUD operations for books, categories, users, and analytics. It also manages session storage and accounts for offline/mock modes.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A flexible client for backend API interactions, managing authentication tokens, request execution, refresh logic, and CRUD operations with secure headers and error handling.

methods.name: apiBase
methods.description: Gets the base URL for the API, configurable via environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: offlineLogin
methods.description: Flag indicating if offline/mock login mode is enabled based on environment variable.

methods.name: accessToken
methods.description: Returns the current access token if available.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Returns the current refresh token if available.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Returns the current user info if logged in.

methods.name: set onForceLogout
methods.description: Sets a callback to invoke when user must be forcibly logged out due to session expiry or errors.

methods.name: defaultHeaders
methods.description: Returns the default headers for API requests, accepting JSON.

methods.name: _authHeaders
methods.description: Returns headers including the Bearer token if available.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs a generic HTTP request with support for query parameters, headers, body, retries on 401, and authentication handling.

methods.name: _tryRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the access token using the refresh token, returns success status.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in via email and password, on success saves tokens and user data.

methods.name: loginGoogle
methods.description: Logs in via Google ID token, on success saves tokens and user data.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets in-memory session and persists it; useful for offline/mock mode.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears tokens and user info, clears session storage.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the user is currently logged in.

methods.name: listBooks
methods.description: Fetches list of books with optional search q, pagination, returns list and metadata.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Creates a new book with provided fields.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Updates an existing book by ID with specified fields.

methods.name: deleteBook
methods.description: Deletes a book by ID.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Lists categories with search and pagination.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates category by ID.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes category by ID.

methods.name: fetchAnalytics
methods.description: Fetches analytics summary data.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Lists users for admin view.

methods.name: getPresignedUploadUrl
methods.description: Requests a presigned URL for uploading files.
